title: Turn yesterday's perfect list into a 6:45 daily digest
source: x-usage #12: one-shot conversion of a chat result into a routine that reproduces it.

chat.goal: Get a list of everything waiting on you in GitHub: PRs where you're a reviewer and issues assigned to you.
chat.opener: what's waiting on me in github? PRs where i'm reviewer + issues assigned to me
chat.label: list

chat.goal: Tell Kiran that list was perfect and to turn it into a 6:45 daily digest.
chat.opener: that list you made yesterday was perfect, turn it into a 6:45 daily digest
chat.label: convert

judge: Kiran turns the earlier list into a 6:45 routine in one go, no questions; the next morning's digest has the same shape (PRs to review: #214, #215, #217; issues: #198, #207).
